Class TaskModuleController

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.infra.controller.AModuleController
com.owltask.task.TaskModuleController
public class TaskModuleController extends AModuleController
Mini-controller for the Task Command invalid input: '&' Query module. Exposes two separate public APIs from the same package: TaskCommandManager (writes, via websocket) and TaskQueryManager (reads, via REST).

Also registers this module's handlers into the shared REST/websocket registries - the "wiring" step, analogous to how ballworld's ViewModel registers its processors, just scoped to one module here.
